title_en: The Night He Queued for a Phone
note_en: 既…也… means "both … and …," linking two feelings or facts that are true at once and often pull in opposite directions: 心里既有骄傲，也有不安 "he felt both pride and unease." It is close to 又…又… but sounds more formal. The next sentence then unpacks each half with 骄傲的是…；不安的是… "what made him proud was…; what made him uneasy was…."
